summary: Backend-only iteration 6. 74/74 pytest cases pass (66 previously-passing + 8 new for /api/live/aathman-current). New endpoint contract verified end-to-end against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Live sample response: {is_live_now: false, video_id: 'Hr9A3KjG7Ys', title: 'GLS Gurupooja live', thumbnail: 'https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Hr9A3KjG7Ys/hqdefault.jpg', channel_id: 'UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg'} — matches spec exactly. Verified: (1) response has all 5 required keys, (2) channel_id == 'UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg', (3) thumbnail follows https://i.ytimg.com/vi/{video_id}/hqdefault.jpg pattern when video_id present, (4) is_live_now is a Python bool, (5) endpoint is unauthenticated and returns 200 in <8s (~600ms cold, <100ms warm), (6) 60s in-memory cache — two back-to-back calls return byte-identical payload, (7) strong-signal detection working — bare 'isLive:true' correctly treated as false (upcoming stream not misreported as live). Regression: /api/live/aathman-channel returns same fixed contract; /api/live/sessions still returns rows with youtube_channel_id=UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg and no legacy youtube_id; kind filters (satsang, yoga) still return >=1 row each. Full previously-green suite (auth, profile, meditations, mantra, mood, diary, rank, books/orders, guru messages, quote-today, Q&A, SOS, sleep, music, guruji image migration, points/stats, community/info, emergent-session error paths, live_attend idempotent 100-point award) still green. MOCKED: Razorpay verify auto-succeeds; SendGrid replaced by dev_otp when OTP_DEV_MODE=true.

minor.issue: Regex on line 734 uses double-escaped backslashes ('\\.') which in a raw string still matches a literal backslash, so the canonicalUrl-JSON path never fires. Fallback regexes on lines 736/738 correctly pick up the video_id, so behaviour is fine, but the first regex is effectively dead code — should be r'"canonicalUrl":"https://www\.youtube\.com/watch\?v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})'.
No Cache-Control header set although payload is cached server-side for 60s. Setting Cache-Control: public, max-age=30 would let mobile clients skip a network round-trip too.

On httpx failure the result is still cached for 60s. If YouTube throws a transient 5xx the app is stuck reporting is_live_now=false + null video_id for a full minute. Consider caching failures for only ~10s while still caching successes for 60s.
(Carried) File is now 1304 lines (up from 1225). Split into routers (auth, points, content, commerce, community, live) is overdue.
(Carried) No unique compound index on {user_id, session_id}.
(Carried) dev_otp is returned whenever SendGrid send fails, not strictly when OTP_DEV_MODE=true.
(Carried) Pydantic v1 body.dict(); migrate to body.model_dump(exclude_none=True).

action_items: None blocking — /api/live/aathman-current contract matches spec, cache works, strong-signal live detection avoids false positives, and video_id is returned even when offline so the chat popout can still be opened.

Optional polish: (1) fix dead regex on server.py:734 (double-escaped backslashes never match — 'r"...\\.youtube\\.com..."' should be 'r"...\.youtube\.com..."'). Fallback regexes cover it today, but the primary/canonical path never fires. (2) Set Cache-Control: public, max-age=30 on /api/live/aathman-current. (3) Cache scrape failures for only ~10s so a transient YouTube blip doesn't wedge is_live_now=false for a minute. (4) Address carried-over items — split server.py, add live_attend unique compound index, gate dev_otp strictly on OTP_DEV_MODE, migrate to Pydantic v2 model_dump.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:697-762 — 60s in-memory cache with an asyncio.Lock double-check is correct and prevents thundering herd. Good.

server.py:744-749 — Strong-signal live detection (isLiveNow:true OR concurrentViewers OR 'watching now') correctly rejects bare 'isLive:true' (upcoming). Verified against real response: is_live_now=false even though the /live page renders a video_id.
server.py:756-757 — thumbnail is derived from video_id via https://i.ytimg.com/vi/{video_id}/hqdefault.jpg — matches spec byte-for-byte.

server.py:734 — Primary canonicalUrl regex uses '\\.youtube\\.com' inside r'...' which matches a literal backslash, not '.'. This regex will never fire; fallbacks on 736 and 738 pick it up. Not a functional bug (still returns correct video_id) but the first-choice detection path is dead.
server.py:758-761 — Failure path still caches the empty result for 60s. Consider a shorter TTL on failures.
server.py has crossed 1304 lines (up from 1225). Split into routers is overdue.

seed_data_creation: No manual seed. Backend seeds meditations, music, sleep_content, live_sessions (all with youtube_channel_id=UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg), guru_messages, quotes, Q&A, books on startup. Startup migration $sets youtube_channel_id and $unsets legacy youtube_id on any existing live_sessions rows. Test users created per-test with TEST_ prefix via conftest user_session fixture. /api/live/aathman-current does live HTTP GET to https://www.youtube.com/@Aathmanawarenesscentre/live — no seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (conftest.py falls back if EXPO_BACKEND_URL is unset). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. /api/live/aathman-current scrapes youtube.com/@Aathmanawarenesscentre/live — expect ~600ms cold, <100ms warm (60s TTL). If YouTube returns HTML in a different shape or throttles the container IP, endpoint still returns 200 with is_live_now=false + video_id=null (graceful, per spec). Two back-to-back calls MUST return identical JSON — cache is tested. Do not treat is_live_now=false with a populated video_id as a bug: the endpoint intentionally returns the latest stream's video_id even when offline so the frontend can open the live-chat popout on an archived stream. Frontend testing intentionally skipped this iteration per review_request.
